title: overlay-check re-sim omits advance_gate_on — the B1 flag-threading fix missed the third Demo_Replay site, so gate demos render their gate-off state in the PP_DEBUG verification verb
detail: The r1 B1 fix threaded advance_gate_on through run_demo and load_demo_replay but not overlay_check's cfg. `overlay-check advance_fire 60000` re-sims gate-off: no fire, era stays 2, no streaming — the verification artifact misrepresents the blessed golden (the B1 bug class, in a debug verb).
recommended_fix: Add `advance_gate_on = d.advance_gate_on` (and the pre-existing `growth_on = d.growth_on`) to overlay_check's Demo_Replay literal so the overlay renders the demo's real run setup.
